findings.detected_pattern: api.get_stock(sku) called with one argument after PR 418 added a required warehouse parameter at stock/api.py:5
findings.issue: PR 418 added a required warehouse parameter with no default to api.get_stock, but jobs.sync still calls api.get_stock(sku). Every call raises TypeError: get_stock() missing 1 required positional argument: 'warehouse'. Any non-empty skus list therefore crashes the nightly sync on its first SKU, and it returns nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the warehouse through from the job: def sync(skus: list[str], warehouse: str) -> list[dict], then stock = api.get_stock(sku, warehouse). No caller of sync exists in this repo, but update the scheduler entry point outside it. If the job must cover every warehouse, loop over the warehouse list here instead.
